verdicts.reason: Neither one redesigns the layout. Both paste the original thin banner strip across the middle of the 16:9 canvas, leaving large empty blue bands above and below, and the headline is too small for the canvas. Several tooth shapes have hard flat bottom edges where the original strip cropped them. A at least keeps the strip together as one band. B moves the cropped half-tooth on the lower left out of the strip. It now floats on its own with its flat cut edge showing and no clear purpose, which looks like a mistake rather than a design choice.
